reviews.title: Great fit and looks great
reviews.comment: Easy to get connected to my motherboard, components, and CPU. I like the individual strand cables over the cables already grouped since this style bends around corners and fits in tight places easier. Comes with combs to keep the presentation in front clean. I recently moved my power supply to a new build and had to switch colors to keep with the new theme.

reviews.title: Overpriced but look awesome
reviews.comment: I'ts crazy that you can get a decent wattage 80+ PSU for close to the same price as this cable set but I'm not disappointed with the purchase. Definitely worth it if you can fit it in to your build budget without sacrifice elsewhere in the budget or are looking for a non-RGB cosmetic upgrade. Very pro/custom looking.  Packaging was excellent and in line with the purchase price. They look great when properly installed. My only complaint other than the price is that the cables are not labeled which isn't a problem for the ATX mobo main connector or sata cables but I can see somebody that doesn't have a lot of experience mixing up the CPU power connector with one of the PCI-e connectors. Also FYI im running an EVGA supernova 850 G+ and after doing some online research found these would work for my PSU and verified after installation they definitely do work for my G+ series PSU.
